rationale: Both drugs are SSRIs with overlapping mechanism. A graded cross-taper over ~11 days minimises both serotonin-syndrome risk on overlap and discontinuation symptoms on the sertraline side. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

schedule.notes: Start escitalopram 5 mg. Halve sertraline to 50 mg from day 4.
Continue escitalopram 5 mg. Hold sertraline at 50 mg.
Reduce sertraline to 25 mg. Increase escitalopram to 10 mg target.

doseRatios.equivalencyNote: Approximate clinical equivalency: sertraline 50 mg ≈ escitalopram 10 mg (Maudsley 14th ed.). Equivalency is approximate and should not be used outside this reviewed pair. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.
